items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You knew maybe Desdunes you said? ... Yeah, I heard of Desdunes.

ctx.x: You knew maybe Desdunes you said? You knew maybe Desdunes? Desdunes, I heard of Desdunes. Actually, they lived on Culledama Street. Yeah, okay. Yeah, I heard of Desdunes.
